dependencies.description: Names of other selected execution plugins, in earlier load order. Native Cordis services such as systemPrompt belong in entry.inject, not here; use [] when there are no plugin dependencies.

capabilities.description: Execution boundary declarations. System prompt contributions use public-context. These names match the existing execution allowlist.

assets.description: Additional workspace-relative files to freeze; entry and plugin.json are always included.

tools.description: Exact additional tool names registered by the plugin, if any.

displayName.description: Concise user-facing Chinese name; optional for legacy plugins.

functionSummary.description: Plain Chinese explanation of capabilities, when they act, and limitations. Intended function, not a claim of verified effectiveness.

mechanism.description: Plain Chinese account of how this plugin works: trigger/input, actions, output and key limitations. Describe advisory versus actual execution in prose, not separate behavior labels or only SDK interface names. Intended mechanism, not verified effectiveness.

categories.description: Optional, multi-select reading categories: 提示与上下文、工具能力、工具结果处理、执行控制与恢复、其他扩展. Missing/empty means not classified. These are not execution permissions or behavior modes.
